paper.title: Improving neural networks by preventing co-adaptation of feature detectors

result.summary: 这篇论文提出了一种名为 dropout 的方法，在每次训练样本呈现时以 0.5 的概率随机省略一半的隐藏单元，以防止特征检测器之间产生复杂的共适应 [p1][p3]。作者在 MNIST、TIMIT、CIFAR-10、ImageNet 和 Reuters 等多个基准任务上验证了 dropout 的效果 [p6][p8][p10][p11][p13]。结果显示 dropout 在所有这些任务上都带来了改进，并在语音和物体识别上创造了不使用先验知识或增强训练集条件下的新纪录 [p1][p7][p9][p11]。

research_question.text: 论文要解决的问题是：当大型前馈神经网络在小型训练集上训练时，通常会在留出的测试数据上表现很差，即过拟合 [p1][p2]。作者指出，过拟合的原因是特征检测器被调整成在训练数据上协同工作良好，但在测试数据上则不然 [p2]。

evidence.quote: When a large feedforward neural network is trained on a small training set, it typically performs poorly on held-out test data.
the feature detectors have been tuned to work well together on the training data but not on the test data.

method.text: 论文提出 dropout 方法：在每次呈现每个训练样本时，以 0.5 的概率随机将每个隐藏单元从网络中省略，使隐藏单元不能依赖其他隐藏单元的存在 [p3]。训练使用标准随机梯度下降，但将通常的权重惩罚改为对每个隐藏单元输入权重向量的 L2 范数设置上界，若权重更新违反该约束则通过除法重新归一化 [p4]。测试时使用包含所有隐藏单元但输出权重减半的“平均网络” [p5]。

evidence.quote: On each presentation of each training case, each hidden unit is randomly omitted from the network with a probability of 0.5, so a hidden unit cannot rely on other hidden units being present.
we set an upper bound on the L2 norm of the incoming weight vector for each individual hidden unit.
If a weight-update violates this constraint, we renormalize the weights of the hidden unit by division.
At test time, we use the “mean network” that contains all of the hidden units but with their outgoing weights halved

experiments.text: 论文在多个基准数据集上评估 dropout：MNIST 手写数字识别（60,000 训练图像、10,000 测试图像）[p6]、TIMIT 干净语音识别 [p8]、CIFAR-10 物体识别（50,000 训练图像、10,000 测试图像）[p10]、ImageNet 物体识别 [p11] 以及 Reuters 文档分类（201,369 篇文档、50 个互斥类别）[p13]。对于语音和两个物体识别数据集，作者通过留出的验证集来选择网络架构，再用在验证集上表现最好的架构评估 dropout 在真实测试集上的性能 [p12]。

evidence.quote: It contains 60,000 28x28 training images of individual hand written digits and 10,000 test images.
We then applied dropout to TIMIT, a widely used benchmark for recognition of clean speech with a small vocabulary.
These images were labeled by hand to produce 50,000 training images and 10,000 test images
ImageNet is an extremely challenging object recognition dataset consisting of thousands of high-resolution images of thousands of classes of object.
We created training and test sets each containing 201,369 documents from 50 mutually exclusive classes.
We made these decisions by holding out a separate validation set that was used to evaluate the performance of a large number of different architectures

findings.text: 在 MNIST 上，不使用任何技巧的标准前馈神经网络最佳已发表结果为 160 个测试错误，使用 50% dropout 和每个隐藏单元输入权重的独立 L2 约束可降至约 130 个错误，再随机丢弃 20% 像素可进一步降至约 110 个错误 [p6]。在 TIMIT 上，不使用 dropout 的识别率为 22.7%，使用 dropout 后提升至 19.7%，这是不使用说话人身份信息方法的纪录 [p9]。在 CIFAR-10 上，不使用变换数据的最佳已发表错误率为 18.5%，作者用卷积网络达到 16.6%，在最后一个隐藏层使用 dropout 后达到 15.6% [p10]。在 ImageNet 上，作者用单个神经网络达到 48.6% 错误率，在第六个隐藏层使用 50% dropout 后降至创纪录的 42.4% [p11]。在 Reuters 上，使用 50% dropout 将错误率从 31.05% 降至 29.62% [p13]。

evidence.quote: the best published result for a standard feedforward neural network is 160 errors on the test set.

This can be reduced to about 130 errors by using 50% dropout with separate L2 constraints on the incoming weights of each hidden unit and further reduced to about 110 errors by also dropping out a random 20% of the pixels
Without dropout, the recognition rate is $22.7$ % and with dropout this improves to $19.7$ %, which is a record for methods that do not use any information about speaker identity.
The best published error rate on the test set, without using transformed data, is 18.5%.
We achieved an error rate of 16.6% by using a neural network with three convolutional hidden layers
Using dropout in the last hidden layer gives an error rate of 15.6%.
We achieved comparable performance of 48.6% error using a single neural network
Using 50% dropout in the sixth hidden layer reduces this to a record 42.4%
A feedforward neural network with 2 fully connected layers of 2000 hidden units trained with backpropagation gets 31.05% error on the test set. This is reduced to 29.62% by using 50% dropout
